test_title: PYST 12: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between D and L when counted from the right of L. Only three people sit between K and I when counted from the left of K. B sits to the immediate right of D. J is an immediate neighbour of L as well as I. Who sits second to the left of C?
solution:
Persons: B, C, D, I, J, K, L (7 persons)

All sitting around a circular table facing centre

**Left = clockwise**

**Right = anticlockwise** 

3 persons between D and L from the right of L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d666eaacb641b211dd3f3ec7d540d0ceca1776387d8f72684a4f0d52f271113.png] 

3 persons between K and I from the left of K

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d76749f3cf1fbee746ba512a88435883f9c2dcabe77f2cac98db32a3c182274.png] 

B immediate right of D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfefa7ea7fc8ae28b41d8e9d7f39279a5ffa097683f2c7d7afed2a298d2949ba.png] 

J neighbour of L and I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ff22013062b8f9389edef75d33d9f7a157ace6fc1cf994b5be6a9e75f56800.png] 

Final arrangement 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb650ecb5c23ed926560875b0044393adb8963d73b44e5bd890e6ce7422181b1.png] 

**Find second left of C:**

Left of C → I

Second left → J

**∴ J sits second to the left of C.**
